plugins.name: secret-env
plugins.description: Inject secrets from private stores straight into the Bash subprocess environment; model context never sees values. Requires the global command `npm i -g @foperate/secret-env`.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 密钥从私有库（KeePassXC 库/OpenViking/Bitwarden/1Password）直达 Bash 子进程环境，模型上下文只见占位符/变量名，永不见值。需先全局安装命令 `npm i -g @foperate/secret-env`
